entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Hans–Ulrich Freiherr von Luck und Witten, usually shortened to Hans von Luck, was a German officer in the Wehrmacht of Nazi Germany during World War II. Von Luck served with the 7th Panzer Division and 21st Panzer Division. Von Luck is the author of the book Panzer Commander.
